objective: The user reports hitches entering or leaving party and raid. Continue attribution and fixes across the addon. Native latency acceptance remains active.

changes.junctionOwnership: Parallel backups stay indexed by shared source. Each junction keeps its own prepared perpendicular continuations for this planning pass. Consume the lists in the same order and preserve root, overlap, paint and budget checks.

coldAndRepeatedBorder.counts: A first switch visits 867 to 345 candidates and copies 33,408 to 0 duplicate scalar entries. All 928 first-switch fallback calculations still complete.
coldAndRepeatedBorder.timingQualifier: Desktop fixture timestamps include observer instrumentation. Reported runtime is noisy and no native FPS or hitch reduction is inferred.
